items.q: When is the best time to visit the Sahara?
items.a: October through April, when daytime temperatures are comfortable and nights are cool. Summer months (June–August) can be extremely hot during the day.

items.q: How do I get to Merzouga?
items.a: Merzouga is about a 9–10 hour drive from Marrakech or a 6 hour drive from Fès. We can arrange private 4x4 transfers, or you can take a domestic flight to Errachidia and a short transfer from there.

items.q: Do I need to be fit for the camel trek?
items.a: Our standard treks are gentle and suitable for most travelers. For the multi-day crossings a basic level of fitness helps — you'll be walking alongside the camels for a few hours each day.
Layers are essential — warm clothes for the evening, sun protection for the day, and a small daypack. We send a full packing list after booking.

items.q: Is the camp suitable for children?
items.a: Yes. Many of our experiences welcome children, and the family-focused departures are designed with kids in mind. Let us know your group and we'll recommend the right trip.

items.q: Can I book a private departure?
items.a: Absolutely. Most of our tours can be run as private departures, and we also build fully bespoke itineraries. Get in touch and we'll tailor everything to your group.
